# library-name-pattern: # classes: own (our code, BSD) bsd mit isc zlib apache apsl lgpl gpl closed-apple

note: GNUstep Base: library sources LGPL-2.1 (tools are GPL, not linked)
GNUstep GUI: LGPL-2.1 except Source/GSIconManager.m (GPL-only: do not ship that file in the library)
FreeType (FTL / GPLv2: used under the FTL)
from the user's Mac (macdeps): never distributed
x264 is GPL-2: a process that loads it is a GPL work
FFmpeg: LGPL, GPL when built with --enable-gpl (x264 present: treat as gpl)
dbus: AFL-2.1 or GPL-2+ (use under AFL)
